messages:
alex_k: kicking off a short sync — we need quota + networking increases for the cross-cloud capacity sprint (US + EU). goal: add ~40 GPU instances across GCP/OW/azure, and bump NIC/ENI limits.
maya_r: thanks. which GPU SKUs and regions are we targeting? also any cost cap we should respect?
vincent_p: primary targets: g4dn/a5000 equivalent spot (for dev), and a100/rtx6000 reserved for prod burst. regions: us-west1, us-east4, eu-west1. note: eu-west3 has no a100s available for next 6w.
sre_linda: @alex_k can you paste the support-case template? i'll file once we confirm numbers. infra-bot: deploybot noted: "quota-request-workflow v2" guideline available at https://internal.redwood/ops/quota-workflow :information_source: 
alex_k: pasting the template we use — keep minimal fields, include projected qps and sample workloads. file subject: "Quota request: Redwood - <ORG> - GPU & Network increases"
```
project: redwood-prod-<org>
cloud: GCP|AWS|AZURE
region: us-west1
requested_gpus: 20 (a5000-preemptible) + 10 (a100-onnode)
current_gpus: 2
requested_vcpu: +160
requested_enis: +80
justification: training/eval + inference burst for dedicated tests, timeline 6/1-9/1
cost_cap: monthly soft cap $45k (notify on exceed)
contact: infra@redwood.com
```
maya_r: looks good. for AWS cases we should include the AMI family and instance type mapping (p4d vs g5) to avoid slow approvals.
vincent_p: ops note: when filing GCP quota, include "quota increase for GPUs (NVIDIA T4/A100)" and attach the predicted token throughput doc. approvals are faster if we list project budget owner.
alex_k: rough numbers per cloud: GCP 20 GPUs, AWS 12 GPUs, AZURE 8 GPUs. network: bump per-account external IP quota by 50, and per-vpc route table size from 100 -> 200 for pod-heavy subnets.
sre_linda: i'll open the AWS support case now. tagging @maya_r as billing owner for cost approval.
maya_r: :thumbsup: i'll review and add the cost justification. can we default to preemptible/spot where feasible?
vincent_p: yes — prefer spot for dev + training. prod infer should be reserved. also consider fallback region eu-north1 if eu-west1 saturates.
alex_k: timeline: open cases today, target approvals in 48-72h. if anything blocks, escalate to infra oncall.
infra-bot: reminder: include billing tag: "team:infra", "project-type:dedicated", "env:staging|prod" for cost tracking.
sre_linda: filed AWS case 11223344, GCP case 99887766, AZURE request 554433. attached template + workload doc. will update thread with links when we have case numbers.
maya_r: thanks team — i'll post the cost approval PR once cases are green. :handshake:
